import sys
input = sys.stdin.read
data = input().split()

n = int(data[0])
m = int(data[1])
a = int(data[2])
b = int(data[3])

# Calculate remainder of n when divided by m
remainder = n % m

# If n is already divisible by m, no cost is needed
if remainder == 0:
    print(0)
else:
    # Calculate cost to build enough boxes to make n divisible by m
    build_cost = (m - remainder) * a
    
    # Calculate cost to demolish enough boxes to make n divisible by m
    demolish_cost = remainder * b
    
    # The minimal cost will be the lesser of building or demolishing
    print(min(build_cost, demolish_cost))
T_solution:
import sys
input = sys.stdin.read
data = input().split()

n, m, a, b = map(int, data)

if n % m == 0:
    print(0)
else:
    min_cost = min((m - n % m) * a, (n % m) * b)
    print(min_cost)
